answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph with beacon, river, and forge as trusted seeds. Trust is the mass of bounded-length random walks from these seeds, not a claim copied indefinitely through transitivity. A sybil cluster S with a sparse boundary has low conductance, φ(S)=cut(S,V\S)/vol(S). A min-cut bound limits walk flow into S and thus caps its aggregate voting weight, regardless of how many identities it creates internally.
